uzo.purpose: Shows many records with the same fields as rows and columns, so a person can compare and find: standards, versions, findings; a foot row (tfoot) holds sums.

instead.kialo: One record has no rows to compare, because its fields are names and values; that is the atributlisto.
A table for the layout of a page destroys the reading order, because assistive technology reads it as data; a person decides how the page is built.

The actions on one row stand behind one button in the row as a menu, because a button per action would fill the row with controls and a person reads the data first; the menuo names each action (Spec 014 ④ closes the boundary row-actions-menu).

boundary.kialo: Pages of a table are navigation between parts of the data, because the table shows one part at a time; the pagxigilo under the table moves between them (Spec 015 ① closes the boundary pagination).
Editing a value in a cell is the lokredaktilo's, because the cell becomes a field with save and cancel on the spot (Spec 025 ③ closes the boundary inline-edit); a form for every cell stays a form.
A coloured row says something only with a word, because colour alone carries no meaning (WCAG 1.4.1); a person decides what the row says and where.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A table fills a section of the page, because it takes the width of its container and scrolls in its own region.

with.kialo: A status in a cell is a badge, because a row's state is one or two words.
A cell or a row header may lead to the record, because the record's page is a destination.
An action on a row is a small butono in its cell, because the action keeps its name next to the row (size small).
A value in a range in a cell is a meter, because a number alone has no scale.
A table without rows shows the empty state over all columns, because the person looks there for the rows.
The sort arrow in a sortable head cell is an ikono (sort-ascending, sort-descending), because the direction is a sign of the Ikonaro the Aspekto draws; aria-sort says it aloud.
The caption of a table names the rows, visible above them; where the section around the table has a heading, that is a titolo.
The row actions of a table are a menuo in the last cell of the row, because one button per row keeps the row readable; the menu names edit, duplicate, delete.
A table with more rows than one page shows gets a pagination under it, because the table shows one part at a time and the person moves between the parts there.

case.de: Gezeigt wird ein einzelner Datensatz mit Namen und Werten.
case.en: A single record with names and values is shown.

case.de: Ein Wert in einer Zelle soll an Ort und Stelle bearbeitet werden.
case.en: A value in a cell is to be edited in place.

case.de: Die Tabelle soll nur das Layout einer Seite ordnen.
case.en: The table is only to order the layout of a page.

do.de: Benenne die Tabelle mit einer Beschriftung; mit caption-hidden bleibt sie für Screenreader da.
do.en: Name the table with a caption; with caption-hidden it stays for screen readers.

do.de: Leg die Aktionen einer Zeile hinter ein Menü in der Zeile.
do.en: Put the actions of a row behind a menu in the row.

do.de: Wähle density und lines nach der Menge der Daten; mit dem Seitenumschalter darunter geht es durch lange Listen.
do.en: Choose density and lines by the amount of data; with the pagination below, long lists are paged.

dont.de: Eine Zeile nur durch Farbe hervorheben, ohne ein Wort dazu.
dont.en: Mark a row only by colour, without a word to it.

dont.de: Erwarten, dass die Tabelle selbst sortiert; sie meldet den Wunsch, die Anwendung sortiert.
dont.en: Expect the table to sort itself; it reports the wish, and the application sorts.

action.de: Auf dem Kopf einer sortierbaren Spalte bitten die Tasten, nach ihr zu sortieren; ein zweites Mal kehrt die Richtung um.
action.en: On the header of a sortable column the keys ask to sort by it; a second time reverses the direction.

action.de: Auf dem Kästchen einer Zeile bittet die Taste, die Zeile aus- oder abzuwählen; das Kästchen im Kopf bittet um alle Zeilen.
action.en: On the box of a row the key asks to select or deselect the row; the box in the head asks for every row.
